//: Shots for Watch-Screenshots.ps1. Every `pattern` was checked against an AegisLog call that actually exists at Info level or above - a shot whose marker is only logged at Debug will never fire, because AegisLog.Level defaults to Info.

shots.caption: The keypad asking for a PIN before a locked craft may be recovered
shots.requires: Lock a craft and land it AWAY from the KSC (or select it in the Tracking Station), then press Recover. The keypad titled 'Aegis PIN - authorise recovery' should be on screen.

shots.caption: The 'press Recover again' toast after a correct PIN
shots.pattern: \[IkosAegis\]\[INFO\] Recovery authorised for .* on a correct PIN\.
shots.requires: In the recovery keypad above, enter the CORRECT PIN. Toast appears at upper centre for 6s.

shots.caption: A wrong PIN refusing a recovery
shots.requires: In the recovery keypad, enter a WRONG PIN.

shots.caption: Crew refused EVA from a locked craft
shots.pattern: \[IkosAegis\]\[INFO\] Refused an EVA from locked vessel
shots.requires: Lock a CREWED craft, then try to send a Kerbal on EVA (portrait EVA button, or the hatch menu).

shots.caption: Docking ports disabled on a locked craft
shots.requires: Lock a craft that HAS at least one docking port, with the port's part menu open so the disabled state is visible.

shots.caption: The keypad locked out after repeated wrong codes
shots.pattern: \[IkosAegis\]\[INFO\] Rejected a PIN on .*keypad disabled for
shots.requires: Enter a WRONG PIN three times in a row on the same craft. The third refusal adds 'Keypad disabled for 30s.'

shots.caption: Refusing to lock a craft that has no PIN set
shots.pattern: \[IkosAegis\]\[INFO\] Refused to lock .*: no PIN is set\.
shots.requires: On a fresh craft with 'Aegis: No PIN set', press Engage Aegis Lock without setting a code first.

shots.caption: A craft whose PIN was set by another player or on another machine
shots.pattern: \[IkosAegis\]\[INFO\] Refused to (unlock|lock|change the PIN on) .*not written by this machine
shots.requires: NEEDS A SECOND WINDOWS USER ACCOUNT OR MACHINE. Lock a craft as user A, log in as user B, load the same save and press Disengage Aegis Lock. Skip this one if that is not practical.
